text_block_list.text:
Before training, Matikanefukukitaru called 
me out to the library—and it was pitch 
black inside.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Fufufufu... Welcome! You are the very 
first lost Fuku-sheep...
(Clap...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Gyawaaa! So bright! Why did you turn on 
the lights~!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I worked so hard setting the mood, too... 
Now it's completely ruined, y'know~?
choice_data_list: What did you want to talk about?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Ayaya, straight to the main point!? Does 
that mean you're super interested!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
That's right! I was thinking of 
incorporating you into my fortune-telling 
today, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right! I call it... "Trainer 
Fortune-Telling"!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
"It's simple: just pick a card! The 
picture on it will be the key to showing 
the results of my training today!!"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Come right up! There are three cards on 
the desk, so please pick whichever one you 
like!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Please, oh please give me something on the 
level of great fortune~!! *sparkle 
sparkle*...

...Matikanefukukitaru is looking this way 
with an expectant gaze... Now then, which 
card should I choose?
choice_data_list: The suspicious card on the right
The suspicious card in the middle
The suspicious card on the left.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Is that card your final answer?! Then 
please, flip it over!
(Flip...)

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Oooooh! This is...! A drawing of a full 
cheetah!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Cheetahs are symbols of speed, and what's 
more, getting to eat until you're full is 
a wonderful thing!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
In other words, this must be an omen of 
great fortune, good luck for sure! Come 
on, good results, show yourself~!

During the training that followed, 
Matikanefukukitaru beat her personal 
record for a single lap on the track.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Is that a painting of someone 
grasping a high-held flame?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
A blazing flame signifies victory! 
Meaning! It's a metaphor that I'll seize 
something good...!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
I'm totally fired up now!! Trainer, let's 
go for a run!

In the training session that followed, 
Matikanefukukitaru gave it her all and 
seemed to master some new technique.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Hyawawawawa~!? Could this drawing be... 
THAT person with the scythe!?

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, today's training is totally out 
of the question, absolutely no way~!!

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
It portends the end of the world, rampant 
tragedy, groping in the dark, massive 
heartbreak, and a supernova explosion! 
Uwaaaah~~!

Afterward, I managed to get 
Matikanefukukitaru to train, but she had 
no energy whatsoever...
